gloss: to nearly die; to be on the verge of death

definitions.gloss: to nearly die; to be on the verge of death; to be about to die
definitions.explanation: To come very close to dying, either literally from illness or accident, or hyperbolically to express extreme discomfort or distress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通事故|こうつうじこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I nearly died in a traffic accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦かけている→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。

⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{溺|おぼ}れて→溺れる：02026_oboreru⟧⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I once nearly drowned to death in a river.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧ (to die) + かける (to be about to; to be on the verge of). The auxiliary verb 〜かける attaches to the masu-stem of verbs to express that an action has started but not completed, or is about to happen. Common in both serious and exaggerated/humorous contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死|し}にかけた⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: a near-death experience
- {死|し}にかけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be on the verge of death; to be dying (literal or hyperbolic)
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{死|し}にかける: to nearly die from the heat

COMMON PATTERNS:
The 〜かける pattern is productive and can attach to many verbs to mean "about to" or "half-": {食|た}べかける (to start eating), {読|よ}みかける (to start reading), ⟦{壊|こわ}れ→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to be about to break).

USAGE:
This is an ichidan verb. Past: {死|し}にかけた. Te-form: {死|し}にかけて. Progressive: {死|し}にかけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧.
